name: Pulihora (Tamarind Rice)
description: Tangy tamarind-infused rice tempered with roasted peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies.

name: Bamboo Shoot Stir Fry
description: Crisp young bamboo shoots wok-tossed with local mountain herbs, garlic, and cold-pressed mustard oil.

name: Assamese Duck Meat Curry
description: Slow-cooked tender duck prepared with ash gourd, black peppercorns, and indigenous whole Assamese spices.

name: Litti Chokha
description: Roasted whole wheat dough balls filled with spiced sattu, served with fire-roasted brinjal and tomato chokha with desi ghee.

name: Chhattisgarhi Muthia
description: Steamed and seasoned savory rice flour rolls lightly tempered with mustard seeds, sesame, and fresh coriander.

name: Goan Fish Curry
description: Fresh catch simmered in rich coconut milk with tart kokum, Kashmiri red chilies, and coriander seeds.

name: Khaman Dhokla
description: Soft and spongy fermented gram flour cakes garnished with tempered mustard seeds, slit green chilies, and grated coconut.

name: Bajra Khichdi
description: Rustic pearl millet and moong dal porridge slow-simmered in an earthen pot and served piping hot with golden homemade ghee.

name: Himachali Dham
description: Traditional celebratory feast centering on red kidney beans (rajma) cooked with yogurt, whole cardamom, and dried ginger powder.

name: Dhooska with Aloo Chana
description: Crispy golden fried pancakes made from soaked rice and chana dal batter, served with spicy homestyle potato-gram curry.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
description: Classic Karnataka comfort dish: rice, toor dal, and fresh garden vegetables slow-cooked in aromatic spice blend and ghee.

name: Appam with Vegetable Stew
description: Lacy fermented rice flour pancakes with pillow-soft centers, served with creamy coconut milk vegetable stew infused with whole cinnamon.

name: Bhutte Ka Kees
description: Indori street classic of grated sweet corn simmered in seasoned milk, flavored with hing, mustard seeds, and fresh grated coconut.

name: Kolhapuri Misal Pav
description: Fiery sprouted moth bean gravy crowned with crunchy farsan, chopped onions, and fresh coriander, served with warm buttered pav.

name: Manipuri Kangshoi
description: Delicate, clear vegetable broth with mountain greens, sliced ginger, king chili, and traditional fermented seasoning.

name: Khasi Jadoh
description: Iconic Khasi specialty of indigenous red hill rice cooked with seasoned meat, ginger, bay leaves, and black sesame paste.

name: Misa Mach Poora
description: Succulent freshwater river shrimp grilled over charcoal with mustard oil, cracked black peppercorns, and fresh lime.

name: Naga Smoked Pork with Bamboo Shoot
description: Dry-smoked pork simmered with fermented bamboo shoots, spicy Naga king chili (bhut jolokia), and crushed garlic.

name: Chhena Poda
description: Revered roasted cheesecake of fresh chhena kneaded with cardamom, sugar, and cashews, slow-baked until richly caramelized.

name: Makki di Roti & Sarson da Saag
description: Golden maize flour flatbreads paired with slow-simmered mustard greens and bathua, served with white butter and jaggery.

name: Dal Baati Churma
description: Clay-baked wheat baatis crushed into hot panchmel dal, accompanied by sweet powdered wheat churma and pure ghee.

name: Sikkimese Steamed Momos
description: Delicate steamed handmade dumplings packed with garden vegetables or minced filling, served with fire-roasted dalle chili dip.

name: Ghee Ven Pongal
description: Creamy rice and yellow moong dal tempered with whole black peppercorns, cumin seeds, fresh ginger, and fried cashews in pure ghee.

name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced marinated cuts, saffron milk, caramelized onions, and cooked under sealed dum.

name: Tripuri Chakhwi
description: Wholesome indigenous stew prepared with tender bamboo shoots, green papaya, jackfruit seeds, and local alkaline seasoning.

name: Lucknowi Tunday Kababi
description: Velvety melt-in-mouth Awadhi minced kebabs infused with raw papaya and a royal blend of over 100 rare aromatic spices.

name: Uttarakhandi Kafuli
description: Traditional Garhwali purée of mountain spinach and fenugreek leaves slow-cooked in iron kadhai with rice flour paste and mustard oil.

name: Bengali Kosha Mangsho
description: Rich, velvety, dark-brown slow-roasted mutton curry cooked with mustard oil, caramelized onions, whole garam masala, and green chilies.
